title: Rashin Tsarki
intro: Bayan tuddai na zamani, akwai labarin ibada mai ƙarfi da kuma amana mai nauyi har da rai da ke ɗauke da ita zai iya karyewa. A lokacin da mutane suka juya ga wauta da zinariya, wani mutum ya tsaya tsayin daka—yana kiran su, yana roƙon haƙuri, kuma yana ɗaukar nauyin alkawari mai tsarki. Wannan shine labarin wanda aka zaɓa a matsayin mataimaki, mai kula da addini, kuma mai kula da imani a lokacin da babu tsarki. Za ku iya gano asalin wannan rai mai ƙarfi?
clues: Ina raba jinin wani babban annabi wanda aka zaba don yin magana da Allah kai tsaye a kan wani dutse mai tsarki.
Ɗan'uwana ya taɓa roƙon Allah ya taimaka masa wajen yin magana a sarari ga babban azzalumi.
Allah ne ya zaɓe ni don in tsaya kusa da ɗan'uwana a matsayin mataimaki da mai kula da gidan.
Tare muka fuskanci wani azzalumi mai mulki wanda ya nemi a kira shi mafi girman alloli.
Yayin da ɗan'uwana ke magana da Allah a kan dutse, mutanenmu sun ƙera wa kansu gunki daga zinariyarsu.
Ni ɗan'uwan Musa ne, wanda Allah ya naɗa a matsayin wazirinsa, an ambace ni da suna a cikin Alƙur'ani.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ وَزِيرًۭا
verse: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant. (25:35)
